posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
OMNITRON - Recycler Gone Mad - ROUND 1

ChronoRanger:
When I was staying in Rook City during a mission one night I saw some documentary on that TV thing about this robot that was collecting garbage and compacting it.  Name was Walleye, or something like that.  So when this robot turned up near home and started picking up trash I sort of figured it was a good thing.  The rats are real bad, like you know, and less trash would mean fewer, or at least smaller ones.

And, well... things got out of hand.
 
Omnitron (100)

[Robot Factory] (Device damage dealt +1)

Start of Turn:
- Omnitron flips from Robot Factory side to Rampaging Recycler side

Play:
Adaptive Plating Subroutine (ongoing)

End of Turn:
Play S-85 Repair Drone (device)

========================
Effects:
- Increase damage dealt by devices by 1 (Omnitron - Robot Factory side)
- Reduce damage dealt to devices by 1 (Omnitron - Rampaging Recycler side)
- After Omnitron is dealt damage, Omnitron becomes immune to that type of damage (Adaptive Plating Subroutine)

(Start of Turn)
- Flip Omnitron's villain character card (Omnitron - either side)

(End of Turn)
- Shuffle villain trash and reveal cards until a component or drone is revealed.  Put it into play (Omnitron - Robot Factory side)
- Play the top card of the villain deck (Omnitron - Rampaging Recycler side)

==========
Omnitron (100) [Rampaging Recycler] (Device DR -1)
S-85 Repair Drone (4) (DR -1)

Golem Unity is up
==========
Golem Unity   - 25
Bunker EOW    - 27
(Sentinels)
Doctor Medico - 13
The Idealist  - 11
Mainstay      - 14
Writhe        - 14
Chrono Ranger - 28
DW Nightmist  - 28

===========
(no environment cards in play)
